name: ABS warning
meaning: There is a fault in the anti-lock braking system. Your normal brakes still work, but the wheels can lock up under hard braking.
action: Drive carefully and leave extra stopping distance. Get the ABS checked at a garage soon.

name: Airbag warning
meaning: The airbag system has found a fault. The airbags may not open in a crash.
action: You can drive, but get it checked as soon as possible. Don't try to fix airbag wiring yourself.

name: Battery / charging
meaning: The battery is not being charged. This is usually the alternator or its belt. The car will run on battery power until it goes flat.
action: Turn off the A/C, radio and other extras. Drive straight to a garage or a safe place. Don't switch the engine off until you get there, it may not start again.

name: Brake system
meaning: The handbrake is on, the brake fluid is low, or there is a fault in the brake system.
action: First check the handbrake is fully released. If the light stays on, stop safely and don't drive. Call for help.

name: Check engine
meaning: The engine computer found a problem, from a loose fuel cap to a sensor or misfire. If it is flashing, the problem is serious.
action: Check the fuel cap is tight. If the light is steady, book a garage visit. If it is flashing, slow down and stop as soon as it is safe.

name: Engine overheating
meaning: The engine coolant is too hot. Driving on can badly damage the engine.
action: Stop safely and switch off the engine. Wait at least 30 minutes before opening the radiator cap. Check the coolant level.

name: Door open
meaning: A door, the boot or the bonnet is not fully closed.
action: Stop and close every door, the boot and the bonnet properly.

name: Fog lights on
meaning: Your fog lights are switched on.
action: Nothing is wrong. Turn them off when visibility is good so you don't dazzle other drivers.

name: Low fuel
meaning: The fuel tank is nearly empty. Most cars have about 40 to 80 km left.
action: Fill up at the nearest fuel station.

name: Oil pressure
meaning: The engine oil pressure is too low. Without oil pressure the engine can be destroyed in minutes.
action: Stop safely and switch off the engine straight away. Check the oil level. Don't drive until it is fixed.

name: Power steering
meaning: There is a fault in the power steering. The steering will feel much heavier.
action: Hold the wheel firmly and drive slowly to a garage. Restarting the car sometimes clears it.

name: Seatbelt reminder
meaning: Someone in the car is not wearing a seatbelt.
action: Make sure everyone has their seatbelt fastened.

name: Traction control
meaning: If it flashes, traction control is working because the road is slippery. If it stays on, the system is off or has a fault.
action: If flashing, ease off the accelerator. If it stays on, drive carefully and get it checked.

name: Tyre pressure
meaning: One or more tyres has low pressure, or there may be a puncture.
action: Slow down and check the tyres at the next fuel station. Pump them to the pressure shown on the driver's door sticker.

name: Washer fluid low
meaning: The windscreen washer fluid is running low.
action: Top it up with washer fluid or clean water when you can.

name: High beam on
meaning: Your main beam headlights are on.
action: Switch to low beam when there is oncoming traffic or a car in front.

name: Cruise control on
meaning: Cruise control is switched on and holding your speed.
action: Nothing is wrong. Press the brake or the cancel button to turn it off.

name: Glow plug (diesel)
meaning: On a diesel, this shows the engine is warming up before starting. If it flashes while driving, there is an engine fault.
action: Wait for it to go off before starting. If it flashes while driving, get the car checked soon.

name: General warning
meaning: The car has a message for you. It usually shows together with another light or a message on the display.
action: Read the message on the dashboard display and check the other lights that are on.

name: Transmission overheating
meaning: The automatic gearbox is too hot. This can damage the gearbox.
action: Stop safely, put it in Park and let the engine idle for a few minutes to cool down.
